The fundamental niche is the full range of environmental conditions under which a species can live and reproduce, while the realized niche is the actual set of conditions in which it exists, considering biotic interactions like competition.  
Here, the birds can nest in treetops or cliffs (fundamental niche includes both), but due to competition, they only use treetops (realized niche).  
Thus, they are using their realized niche only.  

Final answer: (B)
